msg: I'll try to keep this as concise as possible whilst also being detailed! There are two things to note during the game:1) there are four pairs of gnomes: green/pink, brown/orange, red/yellow and blue/purple. They will always appear on screen together. Their height, size, hat type will change but those pairs of colours will always appear on screen together.2) Their colour impacts the colour of the forest you go to to harvest mushrooms: Green, orange, red and blue lead you to a bright forest, whilst pink, brown, yellow and purple take you to a more dark forest.The aim is to try and consistently reach the forest that currently has the most mushrooms, however it's important to remember the number of mushrooms is constantly changing. Try to bear in mind the colour of the gnomes and the forests when trying to find the forest with the highest number of mushrooms.I tried to identify patterns when choosing the gnomes, such as always picking the gnomes that took me to one particular forest consistently. As I mentioned, the number of mushrooms is constantly changing, but try to remember the link between gnome colour and forest colour.Try to stay focused throughout and click through within the alloted time, and make the most of the breaks if you need them! Good luck!
